digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities system (Bedrock model cell configuration)
propositions: native_structured_output is force-disabled for all Claude via _REBAR_OVERRIDES family default, but E1 measured native structured output working under extended thinking on specific Bedrock cells (claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0)

native_output_with_thinking field defaults to False at three ModelCapabilities construction sites (profile path, string-fallback path, _intersect_capabilities), causing overrides that set native_output_with_thinking: True to be silently dropped
_intersect_capabilities must apply conservative all() intersection to native_output_with_thinking across FallbackModel chain candidates, so mixed chains collapse to False

Bedrock opus-4-7 and opus-4-8 are rejected server-side under Converse structured output with thinking and must remain fail-closed (non-rows), while measured cells sonnet-4-6 and dated haiku are enabled via exact _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES rows scoped to E1 account/region
